title: What crosses a workflow boundary
description: Used on the one edge that has two callers and can half-succeed: the writing chain's return. Inline chain steps pass their payload schema directly — wrapping them would be ceremony, since n8n already records every step of an execution.

run_id.description: The n8n execution id of the caller, so a card can be traced back to the batch or the conversation that asked for it.

status.description: partial is the one that matters: the post reached a card but something about it is known to be off — the check failed twice, or the image could not be made.

issues.description: Machine-readable problems, not apologies in prose.
